meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 管理 agent 容器可访问的主机目录:查看、添加、移除挂载允许列表中的目录,并为每个目录设置只读或读写权限;新配置自动作用于新创建的容器。
howto.when: 当提到 “mounts”“mount allowlist” 等关键词,或要求配置 agent 容器能访问哪些目录时触发。

say.text: 查看当前允许挂载的目录,权限如何?
say.note: 展示允许列表及读写状态。

say.text: 把 /data 加为只读挂载,允许 agent 访问。
say.note: 验证路径后写入配置,设为只读。
从允许列表中删除该目录。

howto.what_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access: view, add, or remove entries in the mount allowlist, each set as read-only or read-write. New config applies automatically to new containers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", or ask to configure which directories agents can access.

say_en.text: Show the current mount allowlist and its permissions.
say_en.note: Displays allowed roots and read/write flags.

say_en.text: Add /data as a read-only mount for agents.
say_en.note: Validates path and writes config as read-only.
Deletes that directory from the list.
